description: Phase 3 (bounded) task audit for stack-manipulation. Reclassifies the task's family (marker-transform, like bucket-sort -- NOT Dyck-2-3's implicit-LIFO family, despite surface resemblance as a 'stack-carrier' task). Confirms and QUANTIFIES a confound in flare_a2's hard-negative metric analogous to (and more severe than) missing-duplicate-string's: 87%+ of the nominally-hard population is a trivial O(1) counting check (answer-length arithmetic), not genuine stack simulation.

grammar_confirmation.task_family_reclassification: MARKER-TRANSFORM family (bucket-sort/marked-reversal/marked-copy/odds-first), NOT Dyck-2-3's implicit-throughout-LIFO family, despite both being 'stack-carrier' tasks -- explicit MARKER separates the operation program from its deterministic answer (simulate push/pop, emit reversed final stack).

hard_negative_confound_check.interpretation: CONFIRMED, and MORE SEVERE than missing-duplicate-string's confound: 87%+ of the nominally-'hard' population is length_mismatch (stack_size_arithmetic_consistent violations) -- a pure counting check (push-count minus pop-count plus initial-stack-size vs. observed answer length), requiring NO value simulation. It is classified 'hard' by viol_stack_manipulation ONLY because the answer's total length cannot be confirmed before EOS (must see the whole suffix), not because it requires deep computation. Only ~9-10% of the 'hard' population is genuinely value_mismatch_only, the sole category requiring real LIFO simulation to catch. Any Phase-3 conclusion must be drawn from the value_mismatch_only-isolated population, NOT flare_a2's raw hard-negative accuracy statistic.

joint_all_six.interpretation: The shortcut-blind population is exactly the set of negatives all six counting/parsing checks CANNOT distinguish from a genuine positive -- a purely structural/counting baseline is chance-level on this subset by construction. Expected (and confirmed below) to be dominated by value_mismatch_only, the only category requiring genuine stack simulation.

genuinely_hard_population_definition_for: marker_count_is_one AND operations_well_formed AND stack_size_arithmetic_consistent AND (value_mismatch_only for negatives) -- i.e., exclude both malformed-operation negatives (early-detectable) and length_mismatch negatives (the confound) before drawing conclusions from Condition 3 patching.
